useCases: Sketching a screen flow before anyone opens a design tool

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: Yes — the whole editor runs in the tab and only leaves the browser when you export.

faq.question: Can I keep the files?
faq.answer: Every drawing exports as .excalidraw, PNG, or SVG, so nothing is locked in.
